note: Camera positions/matrices in each receipt are authoritative. Names inherited from the capture script describe drag fractions; the filename back is not a rear-view certificate.

gestures.quarter: horizontal drag of 0.25 canvas heights, about 90 degrees
gestures.half: horizontal drag of 0.5 canvas heights, about 180 degrees; use for rear view
gestures.back: horizontal drag of 1 canvas height, about 360 degrees; full-turn closure observation

selection: unselected for final/; selected section states are in role-aware/ with their own receipts
source_geometry: offline validated fixture/sample envelopes through the actual product store; no live provider
